map.温度缩放 Softmax 观察器，输入 logits 与温度参数观察分布尖锐程度: Temperature Scaling Softmax Observer: enter logits and a temperature parameter to watch how sharp the distribution becomes, building an understanding of how temperature affects probability smoothness.
map.Pᵢ(T) = e^{zᵢ/T} / Σⱼ e^{zⱼ/T}；分布熵 H = −: Pᵢ(T) = e^{zᵢ/T} / Σⱼ e^{zⱼ/T}; the distribution entropy H = −Σ Pᵢ ln Pᵢ
map.温度 T 控制分布锐度：T→0 趋近 one-hot（更确定），T→∞ 趋近均匀: Temperature T controls how sharp the distribution is: as T→0 it approaches one-hot (more certain), as T→∞ it approaches uniform. A high temperature during training exposes inter-class relationships for knowledge distillation; but temperature scaling only changes sharpness, not the ranking, so it cannot fix ranking errors in the model itself.
map.温度缩放 y_i=exp(z_i/T)/Σexp(z_j/T)，T>1 使分布更: Temperature scaling y_i=exp(z_i/T)/Σexp(z_j/T); T>1 makes the distribution smoother (more uncertain) and T<1 makes it sharper.
map.T→∞ 趋近均匀分布，T→0 趋近 one-hot(argmax)。: As T→∞ the distribution approaches uniform; as T→0 it approaches one-hot (argmax).
map.温度常用于调节生成多样性与模型校准，不改变 argmax 类别。: Temperature is commonly used to tune generation diversity and model calibration; it does not change the argmax class.
: logits=[2,1,0.5] with T=1 → probabilities ≈[0.56,0.21,0.23]; T=2 → [0.46,0.30,0.24] is smoother; T=0.5 → [0.76,0.17,0.07] is sharper. The argmax is always class 1.
map.温度缩放是最简单的后校准方法，调 T 使输出置信度匹配实际准确率；但它只缩放分布: Temperature scaling is the simplest post-calibration method, tuning T so that output confidence matches the actual accuracy; but it only rescales the distribution and cannot correct the direction of wrong predictions.
map.生成时温度设多高？: What Temperature Should I Set When Generating?
map.创意写作用较高 T(0.7~1.0)增多样性，事实问答用低 T(0~0.3)增确: For creative writing a higher T (0.7–1.0) increases diversity, while factual question answering uses a low T (0–0.3) for more determinism; too high produces nonsense and too low becomes repetitive and rigid.
